Name: Bog's Monster Mash
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/YSv2tHyj/1.png[/img]
Do you feel that? The veil is getting thinner...... 59 new monsters have taken over the Stardew Valley town mines! I love being in the mines, but I also know there are lots of different playstyles out in the SDV community that I think we desperately needed a bit of a mines mini rework. BEHOLD BOG'S MONSTER MASH WAS BORN!

This mod retextures all of the vanilla monsters in the Pelican Town Mines. (Yes we will be doing the skull caverns, quarry cave, and dangerous mines with the volcano in the future updates!)

Additionally we have added in MONSTER VARIANTS for more visual variety and for more LOOT variety. 

We have kept all the vanilla drops (though we moved bug meat around a bit, see below in Monster Information), so do not worry it won't mess up your planned mines runs.

There are SUPER RARE sparkly variants in this mod of a lot of the monsters. These are EXTREMELY RARE. If you find one in the mines without running luck food or luck items that is super lucky!

[b]With NEWLY RELEASED [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39430]Bog's Monster Sanctuary[/url] as a companion mod! [/b]
[list]
[*]New Building - Monster Sanctuary with an upgrade![/*]
[*]Raise Monsters on your farm![/*]
[*]New Krobus Letters & Event![/*]
[*]13 new Monster Charmer Rings![/*]
[*]New Summoning Circle machine![/*]
[*]Monsters now drop their Souls![/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Twr6PYj8/2.png[/img]
[left][u][b][size=5]MONSTER INFORMATION[/size][/b]

[/u][b]NOTE: This mod does NOT affect how many monsters spawn! It chooses a variant for the monster after the game has already chosen whether to spawn the monster itself.[/b]

Warning: the information below contains spoilers about the variants' drops.

[spoiler]
[b][u]Bats[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW textures for bat, frost and lava bats. [/*]
[*]No new drops[/*]
[/list][b][u]Bugs[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW Little Ghost textures in green, orange and purple[/*]
[*]NEW DROPS: Torch, frozen tear, spirit torch[/*]
[*]Vanilla bug meat drops have been removed (but extra added to Grub and Cave Fly)[/*]
[/list][b][u]Crab[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: Geode Turtle variants & textures in clay, geode, frozen geode, and magma geode (lava crab)[/*]
[*]UNCOMMON: Omni Geode Turtle - drops Omni Geodes[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Treasure Artifact Turtle - drops Artifact Troves[/*]
[/list][b][u]Duggy[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW seasonal variants like a mandrake! [/*]
[*]NEW DROPS: Seasonal forage[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE Starfruit Mandrake - drops Starfruit Seeds and Starfruit[/*]
[/list][b][u]Dust Sprite[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: Spore Spirit variants & textures in Common Mushroom, Red Mushroom, Morel, Chanterelle[/*]
[*]UNCOMMMON: Purple Spore Spirit[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Magma Spore Spirit[/*]
[*]NEW DROPS: They drop the mushrooms they look like[/*]
[/list][b][u]Ghost[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW texture in green, orange and purple[/*]
[*]NEW DROPS: Torch, spirit torch[/*]
[/list][b][u]Grub[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW texture[/*]
[*]No new drops[/*]
[*]Bug meat drops increased to compensate for Bug changes (separate from vanilla bug meat loot list)[/*]
[/list][b][u]Cave Fly[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW texture[/*]
[*]No new drops[/*]
[*]Bug meat drops increased to compensate for Bug changes (separate from vanilla bug meat loot list)[/*]
[/list][b][u]Metal Head[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: Gem Mimic - drops random gem[/*]
[*]COMMON: Furniture Mimic - drops random piece of furniture (oh yes early house decorating and a reason to run the mines for decorators!)[/*]
[*]UNCOMMON: Weapon Mimic - drops one of these weapons: marriage candidate weapons, ossified blade, dark sword, lava katana, dwarf sword, dwarf hammer, galaxy slingshot[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Golden Chest Mimic - drops Golden Mask, Golden Relic, Treasure Chest, Golden Egg[/*]
[/list][b][u]Shadow Brute[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW goblin textures in brown, green and purple - drops Earth Crystal[/*]
[*]UNCOMMON: Gardener Goblin - drops Garden Pot and Tea Sapling[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Mushroom Goblin - drops Mushroom Tree Seeds[/*]
[/list][b][u]Shadow Shaman[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW textures with skull staff and witch hat - no new drops[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Shadow Enchantress - drops Monster Musk[/*]
[/list][b][u]Skeleton[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]NEW seasonal variants - no new drops[/*]
[*]UNCOMMON: Pumpkin Skeleton - appears the last week of Fall in the mines and drops pumpkins[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Golden Pumpkin Skeleton - [b]may appear any time during Fall[/b] and drops golden pumpkins[/*]
[/list][b][u]Slimes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW slug texture![/*]
[*]No new drops[/*]
[/list][b][u]Big Slime[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW devious slime texture![/*]
[*]No new drops[/*]
[/list][b][u]Squid Kid[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: Oculus - no new drops[/*]
[*]COMMON: Mossy Oculus - drops Moss and Mossy Seed[/*]
[*]UNCOMMON: Bloodshot Oculus - drops void egg and fire quartz[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE: Stardrop Oculus - drops Stardrop Tea[/*]
[/list][b][u]Stone Golem[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]COMMON: NEW copper, iron, and gold ore gargoyle textures - drop their related ores[/*]
[*]UNCOMMON: Iridium Gargoyle - drops iridium ore[/*]
[*]SUPER RARE Prismatic Gargoyle - drops prismatic shards[/*]
[/list]
If a monster drops a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Mines#Special_Items]Special Item[/url] it will not drop anything else - this is vanilla behaviour and we cannot change it. If the monster you killed was a Super Rare and thus meant to have a 100% soul drop (if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39430]Monster Sanctuary[/url]﻿ is installed), we recommend using a mod like CJB Item Spawner to give yourself the soul (if you want to).
[/spoiler]
[/left]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wj7Ymkcz/3.png[/img]
[u][b][size=5]CONFIGURATION[/size][/b][/u]

[b][u]Iridium Color[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Choose between green, pink, or purple for Iridium Ore Gargoyles (Stone
Golems). Will also control their soul color if Monster Sanctuary is installed.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Monster Changes Everywhere[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Enable to allow Monster Mash to edit monsters anywhere they spawn, including
in mod-added regions. This will override any monster of the same type as Monster Mash so if you want to see other mods' custom monsters, do not enable this.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Super Rare Luck[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Choose between Easier, Standard, or Harder (default Standard) to change how
much player luck (not daily luck) affects Super Rare rates[/*]
[/list]
Here is the luck information for those who want to min max and hunt for those Super Rares!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wjR91smZ/luck-info.png[/img]
Option 1 = Easier
Option 2 = Standard
Option 3 = Harder
[size=1](Apologies for having the rates table as an image. We're working on finding a better option.)[/size]

[b][u]Monster Choices[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Disable monster changes for individual monster types as desired. Disabling will remove Monster Mash drops from the monster type as well as disabling its custom variant textures.[/*]
[/list]
[center]See this mod, the entire Bogwood Collection and more in my new youtube series Bogwood Grove!
[youtube]hfF1DBlFluA[/youtube][/center]

[b][u][size=5]ACCESSIBILITY[/size][/u][/b]
[b][u]Vision[/u][/b]
﻿[u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod is partly compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url]﻿. Nothing will break but SA players will not get the full experience.[/*]
[*]Stardew Access does not differentiate between monster variants, so all the variants for a given monster type will be described by the vanilla name. E.g., Shadow Witch, Shadow Wizard, and Shadow Enchantress variants will all be called “Shadow Shaman” by Stardew Access.[/*]
[*]SA players will still be able to receive the additional drops that Monster Mash adds to monsters.[/*]
[/list]
﻿[u][i]Trypophobia[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod has a monster based on a Morel mushroom. It can be disabled in the config by disabling Dust Sprite. Doing so will disable all of the variants for Dust Sprites. We do not have a trypophobia mode at present but intend to add one in our next update.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Sound[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Play with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39416]No Fly Sound[/url]﻿ mod to remove the buzzing sound from Cave Flies.[/*]
[/list]
 We welcome requests for any additional accessibility changes our players may need.

[u][b][size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b][/u]

[list]
[*]NOT COMPATIBLE with other monster retexture mods unless they also use Monster Variety. Mods that add retextures using MV will add their variants to the same list that this mod does, so you will see a mix of monster variants from both mods.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]This mod shouldn't interfere with other mods that change monster drops. The only exception is for bug meat, because this mod removes bug meat drops from Bugs (as they are now little ghosts) and adds extra to Grubs and Cave Flies to compensate.[/*]
[/list]
Here are some mods that I have played with in my mod testing that has added extra fun with Monster Mash!

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29604]Infested Monster Totems:[/url] "Your one-way ticket to monster-hunting paradise! This mod adds 12 unique totems that let you warp directly to areas infested with specific monsters."[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28788]Graveyards:[/url] "During the week of Spirit's Eve, spooky graveyards will show up in the mines, with spooky skeletons alongside!"[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34845]Stackable Monster Musk:[/url] "Allows you to use multiple Monster Musks at the same time for more effectiveness."[/*]
[/list]
[b][u][size=5]UNINSTALLATION[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Sell/trash souls[/*]
[*]Remove mod[/*]
[*]That's it![/*]
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/QtDz0g5t/4.png[/img]
